title: Cardinals CB Will Johnson "just feels right" wearing No. 2 in second Cardinals season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cardinals CB Will Johnson "just feels right" wearing No. 2 in second Cardinals season
sources.description: Will Johnson won a national title and made All-America teams while wearing No. 2 at Michigan, but it wasn't available when he joined the Cardinals as a second-round pick in 2025.
